limitations: Only the numerically equivalent bounded motion cache is enabled by default in production.
The initializer remains a single-tile diagnostic.
Local step limiting still requires descent, positivity and true-objective Armijo acceptance.
Reconstruction covariance, joint convergence, real quality and full phone performance remain unaccepted.
The diagonal fallback is used when physical limiting cannot provide a usable descent direction from the first PCG result. True Armijo and physical positivity remain required.
